lede: Every enemy and character of the live missions, one frame each, drawn at the squad's approved fidelity on the 384 × 216 grid: hand-drawn parts, IK limbs shaded as cloth tubes, selout, one 1 px outline. These are look samples, not animation sets. VINCENT stands first in every line-up for scale.

blocks.title: How to read this page
items: Line-up: each strip is the game's 384 px wide view, so the sizes against VINCENT and against each other are true.
Viewer: click any card to see it large, next to VINCENT. 'Now 1x' adds the frame the game draws today at 1x; 'Now UHD' adds its 4x frame at the same logical size (what a 4K screen shows today).
Every sample: each card shows the sample at the largest whole zoom that fits. The button above the cards puts the current 1x game frame beside each one.
Enemies face left, as they meet the hero in the game.

blocks.title: Changes from the current designs (please confirm)
items: The Swan is the game's riveted ivory robot (plates, rivets, a lens eye, the beak gun). The squad page's rider poses still use a natural feathered swan; one of the two must change.

The robot mayor has a steel robot face with red eye slots instead of a human face, so it is no likeness of any real person. It is 173 px tall (the game's layout height), with long wave locks, a silver chain and heavy robot boots.
The tow truck is 1.2 times longer than in the game (5.3 m instead of 4.3 m at this scale), so it reads as a truck. It faces right, as it backs in during the fight.

The scan car carries no readable PARKEERCONTROLE: the word needs about 59 px and the door is 25 px wide. A band of letter-like marks takes its place, and there is no light bar (the design follows the real car).
The beer bike's keg sits as a barrel on the rear deck, not on the roof.
The trench shovel has a real spade blade; the brute machine gunner is clearly bigger than the other zombies; the crawler has a bare head.
The handhaver's ticket has no BOETE text (it cannot stay legible); Mevrouw Winkel follows the design doc (middle-aged, dark grey hair).

blocks.title: Known weak spots
items: All zombies share one face design; only the headgear tells them apart. On the grunt and the crawler the red band can read as a tie.
Raised arms are short on the rig, so some cheer and wave poses pass an arm behind the head.
Small marks need zoom: the baker's F, the party-shirt star, the L-plate, staff-0's freckles, the cat's stripes.
The Swan is mostly white on white, and its legs are short. The jet Swan's flames are pale on a light sky.
The tide slice has straight cut sides; its back ranks are dark shapes with glowing eyes.

blocks.title: Not drawn on purpose
items: Palette-only variants: the handhaver skins b and c, the delivery-rider skins, the black-headed Swan for player 2. They share the sample's body.
The fatbike looks 1-3 (purple hood, teal cap, orange hood) and the pair on one bike: the same rider and bike with other clothes.
Stag-party looks 1 and 3: defined in the code, but no live section spawns them.
The retired heroes (Grace, Gramps, Mittens, Pip): not selectable and not in a live mission.
The oat mission's cast (makelaar, huisjesmelker, dealer, taxi, bakfiets and others): designed but not built, and the oat work is paused. Its background people are scenery without an outline.
Boats with people painted in, the background cyclists (not spawned), the 3D rally, the FPS mode, the dormant ring mission and the scrapped missions m0-m5.
